verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a self-hosted deployment option built for data residency. The data plane runs in your own infrastructure, and all customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, and prompts) stays in your own cloud account and region, while Braintrust provides the managed UI, authentication and updates. Missing for 10: region selection on the fully managed hosted service, documentation of supported clouds/regions and deployment prerequisites, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Data residency and compliance: Meet regulatory or contractual obligations by keeping all customer data ... within your own cloud account and region.
keeping all customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, and prompts) within your own cloud account and region
You deploy and control the infrastructure that stores your sensitive AI data, while Braintrust provides the managed UI, authentication, and platform updates.
